title: A bounce of the APPLICANT's co-nudge email exhausts a corrected row and fabricates referee_contact_invalid — the W1 gate matches any delivered attempts entry, including the applicant-addressed co-nudge
evidence: find_reference_call_by_send_ref.sql: 'rc.attempts @> NULLIF($1, '')::jsonb' and 'COALESCE((SELECT (e->>'at')::timestamptz >= rc.corrected_at FROM jsonb_array_elements(rc.attempts) AS e WHERE e->>'detail' = $4 AND e->>'outcome' = 'delivered' ORDER BY e->>'at' DESC LIMIT 1), false) AS send_is_post_correction'; webhooks.gleam:297-299: 'case row.matched_send_at == "" || row.send_is_post_correction { True -> exhaust_row(...)'; sweep.gleam:364-366: 'send.send_co_nudge(deps, to_email: row.applicant_email, ...)' then 'outcomes_to_json([outcome], now_iso)' appended to the row's attempts via sweep_advance (send.gleam: 'Ok(email_id) -> ChannelOutcome(Email, Delivered, email_id)')
detail: The co-nudge (sent to the APPLICANT) is appended to the row's attempts as a delivered entry with the applicant-message id. Its bounce matches the row by containment; on a corrected row (cycles>=1) matched_send_at != '' and send_is_post_correction=true -> exhaust_row: unreachable + referee_contact_invalid stamped + audit + notification, though the referee's contact never failed.
recommended_fix: Scope the exhaustion gate to referee-addressed sends: tag attempts entries with the recipient role (referee vs applicant) or exclude co-nudge details from the matched_send_at/send_is_post_correction subqueries, so an applicant-address bounce cannot exhaust a reference row.
